dedupe_keys.name: smhi vattenwebb water flows model data and registers for sweden

description: SMHI produced Vattenwebb, a portal of data, registers and tools for Swedish lakes, rivers and coasts that it runs for the Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management. It offers observations, hydrographic data from the Swedish water archive and modelled flows from the S-HYPE model for all subcatchments, flow data from 1991 for download, current flows for the last 30 days with a ten-day forecast, and a tool comparing natural with regulated flow in regulated lakes and rivers. Coverage is Sweden. The services are free and open to all, with downloads. Caveats: most series are model output, not measurements, and the services are aimed at water managers, not at infrastructure operators. Simulation uses: flow and forecast inputs for flood and drought scenarios and reservoir regulation studies. Related records: the HYPE model (model-smhi-hype-hydrological-model).
